fields.description: STATUS.md render falls back to default ledger — template references 'run' but no ledger named 'run' is registered. Named ledger is 'run-26'. STATUS.md may show stale or incorrect protocol state.

fields.content: 3 new modules not in baseline; HMAC provenance in enforcement._common; read-guard in _sahjhan_bootstrap; 276 lines enforcement churn
815 tests pass, 76% coverage. subagent_findings_check.py at 0% coverage. CI does not enforce coverage gate.
Enforcement subsystem is churn epicenter. 23.4% cold file ratio. 2 cold gate scripts, profiler_plugin.py never audited.
BH-001 CRITICAL ledger template mismatch. Enforcement layer highest risk. PAT-005 and PAT-007 expected to recur.
8 predictions: 2 HIGH (README drift, HMAC auth), 5 MEDIUM (gate scripts, commit gate, subagent hook, parser/emitter), 1 LOW (impact graph rendering).

fields.description: LOC figure 18537 is stale in 3 places. Actual: 22974 total or 7969 production-only.
Research data staleness footnote says Runs 17-18 missing but actually Runs 17-25 are excluded. Misleading.
Run count says twenty-five but Run 26 is in progress. Stale.

active-run marker file has never existed. _active_ledger() always returns None. Hooks write quiz/context events to default ledger, not run-specific ledger. Gate conditions on run-specific ledger cannot see hook events.
count_distinct_reads counts ALL file reads in session transcript, not just final sweep reads. Any session with 30+ total reads passes the gate regardless of whether the final sweep read any files.
record_authed_event calls unprotected from FileNotFoundError when session.key is absent. primer.py wraps with suppress but lens_quiz.py does not.
Read-guard bypass: sed -i, perl -pi, patch, python -c open() all write to protected enforcement/ paths without being blocked.
Unknown severity maps to rank 0. Any valid resolved severity ranks >= 1, so downgrade from typo/unknown severity silently passes without evidence.
Answer count mismatch returns (0,0) which triggers stale-questions error message. Wrong error message for wrong condition.
Test uses flat-format content against min_reads=5 threshold. Rejection is from read-count gate, not rubber-stamp detection. Wrong code path tested.
is_git_commit regex matches git commit inside echo, comments, and quoted strings. Can false-positive block echo commands in fix_loop.
While loop with bare try/except KeyError: pass suppresses production errors. If add_edge broke, test hangs instead of failing.
HMAC null byte injection: field value containing null byte produces payload identical to one with additional fields. Enables HMAC collision/forgery.
test render

HMAC enforcement bypass: session keys are readable by the AI agent. Agent can read the key via Read tool or xxd, compute HMAC proofs using enforcement/hooks/_common.py:compute_event_proof(), and record restricted events (context_reset, quiz_answered, etc.) without hook authorization. The entire restricted-event HMAC system provides zero protection against a motivated agent.

_parse_commit_hash regex fails on root commits and detached HEAD. Pattern requires [branch hash] but git outputs [main (root-commit) hash] which has parenthesized metadata. Returns 'unknown' instead of actual hash.
_truncate() appends '...' without accounting for its 3-char length. Output exceeds max_len when truncating at word boundaries or when no spaces exist before max_len.
verify_answer_freshness uses 1-based line_no directly as 0-based index. Window starts one line late. Practical impact minimal due to ±3 line window.

protocol_tracker._refresh_from_sahjhan populates perspectives_done/total from parse_status_text but never writes current_perspective to cache. _protocol_cache.format_state_line reads cache['perspective'] which stays at default '?'. Status line shows '? 1/13' instead of active perspective name.

Bash read-guard substring matching is case-sensitive. On case-insensitive filesystems (macOS default), alternate-case paths like QUIZ-BANK.JSON bypass the guard. Read tool guard is unaffected (uses os.path.realpath). Only quiz bank is at risk; session keys use structural guard.

_get_session_key_path ignores ledger parameter. Queries sahjhan config session-key-path without --ledger, always returning default ledger key. record_authed_event computes HMAC with default key but targets per-ledger run. Proof mismatch silently fails all restricted events (quiz_posed, quiz_answered, context_reset) for named ledger runs.

verify_answer_freshness checks if quiz answer keywords still appear at the source line number. But any fix that adds/removes lines shifts all downstream line numbers, invalidating quiz questions that haven't changed semantically. After a fix loop with multiple commits, enough questions go stale to permanently block convergence (>MAX_STALE_QUESTIONS). Line numbers are the wrong stability anchor — function names, class names, or content hashes would survive line shifts.
